integrity: Direct hypergeometric payoff calculations were checked by an independent exact-rational implementation and compared with the coupling formula. General claims are established by algebraic proof, not by extrapolation of finite computations.
scientific_limitations: Finite well-mixed two-strategy public-goods model; maximal sign reversals refer to expected payoffs, not trajectory oscillations; sharpness shown at the smallest permitted population, not for each larger fixed population; arbitrary positive increasing returns may not be empirically common. Historical priority remains subject to independent examination.
title: A sharp parity law for oscillatory selection under increasing public-goods returns
